description:
Eugenia, a young widow who lost her husband before her wedding night, accidentally buys a suggestive adult toy at an auction and becomes completely hooked on it. One day, the Pope suddenly appears before her.

"That is mine."   

"Whose? His Holiness the Pope's?"  

"I mean that the sex toy you are holding right now belongs to me."

I... masturbated with the Pope's possession?!   

A dizzying romance between a young widow and a Pope who must remain celibate, centered around the shocking true identity of the toy!
